The institutional investor held 56,875 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.27 million, down from 111,286 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Friess Associates Llc who had been investing in The Children’s Place Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.15B market cap company.
